scope: Isolated public audio comparison only, no deployment, device, business ASR/LLM or paid API

primary.reason: Original Chinese version; published 47M/INT8 profile. Not the larger English-enhanced 1.1.

precision_reference.scope: Same original 20 clips only; not used to select a new threshold or overwrite primary results

decision: Official three-class argmax; complete=0, incomplete=1, invalid=2. Invalid never becomes complete; invalid on a true endpoint counts as missed.
baseline: Pinned smart-turn-v3.2-cpu.onnx and official preprocessing, p>0.5; reuse original fixed results and apply same causal replay.
fixed_set: Keep all 20 IDs, labels and SHA from labeled-corpus.json. Primary no added silence. Report same historical 0/.2/.8/1/2/3s stress groups separately, no selection of best delay.

real_dataset.selection: All well-formed Chinese rows in source order with original entire audio duration <=15 seconds. Do not select by predictions. List every exclusion with reason and original duration.
real_dataset.labels: Original silence_spans; all before last are hold, last is endpoint. Preserve original annotations; no oracle transcript/messages passed to these audio models.

causal_replay.scope: Every original silence span with at least one complete grid point; use audio prefix through that time only, then official tail-8 preprocessing independently per model. No future waveform/words, no extra silence, no forced timeout. Grid is sampling cadence, not a wait-to-pass parameter.
causal_replay.metrics: Per-pause and per-turn early commit; new early commits versus baseline at exact same points; final endpoint missed; late beyond1.5s; invalid counts; all inference/input errors kept. Report rows with short/no eligible pauses separately.

latency: Measure from source silence start to decision including model feature extraction+inference; retain actual serial wall timing for each input. Include single-thread execution, cold load/first inference and hot median/P95/max separately. No claim of microphone/network/Agent/TTS or Android latency.
stop: Run both fixed and real replay even if fixed fails, as requested; failed gate stops product admission. No thresholds, waiting periods, weights, labels or version swapping to turn a failure into a pass.
real_cadence_reference: First 10 eligible Chinese turns in source order, fixed before predictions; actual 1x clock at the same .2s grid, no capture, playback or business messages. Full prefixes remain shadow observations after any premature decision.
